'''Zim Zam Blattis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] leader of a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] gang during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] was tasked by [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] to eliminate Blattis, in which the spacer succeeded.
